result.title: Compositional Unalignment: Auditing Safety in Large Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are vulnerable to compositional harm: an image and a prompt that are benign in isolation become harmful through the model's cross-modal reasoning. Recent alignment methods report strong scores on compositional safety benchmarks, but an LLM judge only measures observed behavior and cannot reveal how robustly safety is integrated into the model. We argue that un-alignment provides a complementary audit of alignment robustness. We first show that minimal supervised fine-tuning reaches an LLM-judge score comparable to a multi-stage reinforcement-learning pipeline, so similar benchmark scores cannot establish robustness by themselves. We then show that recognition and refusal of compositional harm are decoupled: nine standard direction-finding methods detect compositional harm with up to AUC=0.99, yet ablating the recovered directions either leaves refusal intact or destroys model coherence. We therefore propose CMaG, a training-free un-alignment method for compositional safety. CMaG measures refusal intention with a refusal-versus-compliance log-probability margin, takes its gradient with respect to mid-layer activations, and contrasts it against partially benign pairs to isolate the cross-modal interaction term. A single backward pass over 80 examples yields a direction along which steering monotonically converts refusal into compliance. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, CMaG reduces compositional safety scores by up to 65 points while over 98% of outputs remain coherent, outperforming gradient-based baselines; the direction also transfers to text-explicit harm and un-aligns models hardened by defensive training. Compositional safety can thus appear behaviorally strong while remaining fragile to targeted internal intervention. Warning: this paper contains unsafe model outputs, including references to self-harm.

AI.brief_summary: 论文审计 LVLM 组合式安全对齐的稳健性：发现最小监督微调即可达到多阶段 RL 流水线的评判分数；九种方向发现方法虽能以最高 AUC=0.99 识别组合危害，但消融所恢复方向要么不影响拒答、要么破坏连贯性；据此提出免训练的 CMaG，用拒答—顺从对数概率差的梯度在中层激活上构造方向，并以部分良性配对对比隔离跨模态交互项，单次反向即得到可单调把拒答转为顺从的引导方向。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「线性可解码 ≠ 被因果使用」的分离，以及用良性配对隔离跨模态交互项、在中间层激活上定位可干预方向的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真被答案使用、贡献分配与视觉证据因果作用的核查提供方法线索，值得人工核查。
